131 def update_limits(
132 self,
133 voltage_min: float,
134 voltage_max: float,
135 current_min: float,
136 current_max: float,
137 ) -> None:
138 v_min = float(voltage_min)
139 v_max = float(voltage_max)
140 i_min = float(current_min)
141 i_max = float(current_max)
142
143 if v_max < v_min:
144 v_min, v_max = v_max, v_min
145 if i_max < i_min:
146 i_min, i_max = i_max, i_min
147
148 self._voltage_min = v_min
149 self._voltage_max = v_max
150 self._current_min = i_min
151 self._current_max = i_max
152 self.dataChanged.emit()
153
154 def update_output(self, enabled: bool) -> None:
155 self._output_enabled = bool(enabled)
156 self.dataChanged.emit()
157
158 def update_measurement(self, sample: ChannelMeasurement, elapsed_s: float) -> None:
159 elapsed_s = float(elapsed_s)
160 if self._integration_prev_elapsed_s is not None and elapsed_s >= self._integration_prev_elapsed_s:
161 delta_h = (elapsed_s - self._integration_prev_elapsed_s) / 3600.0
162 self._charge_ah += float(sample.current_a) * delta_h
163 self._energy_wh += float(sample.power_w) * delta_h
164
165 self._integration_prev_elapsed_s = elapsed_s
166 self._measured_voltage = float(sample.voltage_v)
167 self._measured_current = float(sample.current_a)
168 self._measured_power = float(sample.power_w)
169 self._last_elapsed_s = elapsed_s
170
171 self._voltage_series.append_point(elapsed_s, self._measured_voltage)
172 self._current_series.append_point(elapsed_s, self._measured_current)
173 self._power_series.append_point(elapsed_s, self._measured_power)
174
175 self.dataChanged.emit()
176
177 def update_totals(self, totals: ChannelTotals) -> None:
178 self._charge_ah = float(totals.charge_ah)
179 self._energy_wh = float(totals.energy_wh)
180 self.dataChanged.emit()
181
182 def reset_series(self) -> None:
183 self._voltage_series.clear()
184 self._current_series.clear()
185 self._power_series.clear()
186
187 def reset_totals(self) -> None:
188 self._charge_ah = 0.0
189 self._energy_wh = 0.0
190 self._integration_prev_elapsed_s = None
191 self.dataChanged.emit()
